class.name: SteamAudioProbeBatchData
class.brief_description: Serialized Steam Audio probe batch with optional pathing and reflection data.

members.member: Number of probes in this batch.
World-space probe positions captured from generated SDK probes, used for gizmos and runtime reflection lookup. Must match the serialized batch's probe order and count.

SDK influence radius corresponding to each probe position. Legacy resources missing positions or radii must be explicitly regenerated before baking; these values cannot be inferred from the current volume settings.
True after a successful listener-centric reflection bake.
